title: Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. 8-K Filing — Q4 and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
summary: Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. (PPSI), a Nasdaq Capital Market-listed power solutions company headquartered in Fort Lee, New Jersey, filed a Form 8-K on April 8, 2026 disclosing Q4 and full year 2025 financial results via an attached press release (Exhibit 99.1). No specific financial figures are contained in the 8-K itself; the filing only references the results. This is a routine corporate disclosure outside the scope of market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. (ticker: PPSI) filed Form 8-K on April 8, 2026.
The filing announces final financial results for Q4 and full year ended December 31, 2025.
The press release (Exhibit 99.1) containing the actual financial figures is referenced but not reproduced in the 8-K body.
The company is listed on Nasdaq Capital Market.
The filing was signed by CFO Walter Michalec.
The filing is furnished (not filed) pursuant to Item 2.02, meaning it is not deemed 'filed' for Exchange Act purposes.
